abstract: Comprehensive guide for building high-performance Node.js native addons using Rust and NAPI-RS. Covers project initialization, export mechanisms (#[napi] macro), class definitions, async functions with Tokio integration, ThreadsafeFunction for multi-threading, Object data passing, and cross-platform build strategies. Includes 5 common patterns, best practices for error handling, type safety, lifecycle management, and performance optimization. Designed for AI agents to assist developers in creating production-ready Rust-Node.js bindings.
